transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on the release package review for 'After the Flood' ahead of the Meridian International Film Festival. I'll need each of you — rights, music, publicity, and accessibility — to walk me through your review of the current draft release sheet before I lock it. I understand the draft currently lists worldwide access, the cue 'Low Tide,' the working title 'River After Rain,' and optional accessibility materials. We also have two files going to the festival: a public screening file and a password-protected press-screening file. Who'd like to begin?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a rights issue before we go any further. I confirmed with the archive this week that the license for the documentary's archival interview permits festival screening and password-protected press access only in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Ireland. It forbids public online access and access in all other territories. The archive's signed email arrived after the last package revision, so I haven't copied the confirmation into the release sheet yet. This means the current draft's listing of worldwide access is not going to be consistent with the license terms.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a music clearance issue. I confirmed with the publisher that the current cue 'Low Tide' is only cleared for 30 seconds, but the trailer segment it's used in runs 46 seconds. The alternate cue 'Northbound' is cleared for the full 46-second segment. I haven't updated the cue name in the package yet because the editor delivered the latest cut after my clearance check, so the release sheet still lists 'Low Tide.' We'll need to either replace it with 'Northbound' or get an extended clearance for 'Low Tide' before Mara locks the package.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: On the publicity side, I need to flag a title and credit issue. I have the filmmaker's signed publicity approval, which requires the title 'After the Flood' and the credit line 'A film by Nia Okafor.' The draft release sheet still lists the working title 'River After Rain' and a generic credit because the signed approval arrived during the poster revision and I haven't updated the sheet yet. We'll need to correct both before Mara locks the package.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: On the accessibility side, I need to flag a deliverables issue. I confirmed with the festival's access coordinator that the final submission must include open English captions and a separate audio-description track. The coordinator will reject a package containing either deliverable as optional. The current draft release sheet lists accessibility materials as optional, so we'll need to update that before Mara locks the package. I haven't updated the release checklist yet because the festival issued this ingest requirement in a separate accessibility email.
